newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker Intl aims at account handling.
newsitem.headline: Schenker Intl aims at account handling.

text.p: Schenker International is to restructure its customer service departments in Germany with account executives giving clients a single point of contact within the company, parent company Schenker-Rhenus AG said.
The new system is designed better to meet the needs of international cargo shippers for reliability, quality, customer orientation and flexibility from a freight forwarder, a statement added.

A Schenker International Germany large-scale survey of 525 cargo shippers showed reliability was the top shipper demand with 95 percent followed by early information (81 percent), low damage levels (73 percent) and high flexibility (71 percent).

Managing director Michael Korn said: "It was a surprise for us that tracking and tracing systems and worldwide networks only achieved middle of the table placements as well as the relatively low value given to DIN ISO EN 9001/9002 certification."
He added: "We will now set up customer service departments with a single point of contact for each client in all locations, including in sea fteight which is new for that industry."

The account handlers would be responsible for ensuring all services were satisfactorily carried Out and would allow for a more rapid handling of any complaints, he said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
